value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Exact-commit consumption check exposed a Bun default-policy gap: Git installation succeeds while blocked dependency preparation leaves the compiled entry absent. Compiled modules are now tracked, with a clean-build byte comparison and tracked-output drift gate. CI will install the exact pushed commit with both npm and Bun and exercise every public export, without changing dependency trust settings.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Real npm Git installation additionally confirmed its preparation uses a source archive without Git metadata. The prepare hook now installs clone-local merge drivers only when the package itself has a Git marker; compilation still runs. This avoids ancestor discovery and supports Git archives. Surface consumers should use the final PR head rather than the early milestone for Git installation.

value.text: Round 2: read all eight unresolved CodeRabbit threads on PR #1 in full. value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation: PR-only concurrency uses a per-run fallback for pushes so neither active nor pending main runs are canceled. Tag/release checks main again after publication for both new and existing tags. Contrast counts come from measured rows; binary detection uses NUL and fatal UTF-8 decoding, preserving text scanning regardless of extension. Previews cover all 24 fixed lockups on theme paper. Revert proof requires a supplied locally available baseline before mutation; alpha supports decimal numbers, with percentages explicitly unsupported. Added real Git-fixture, rendered PNG, shell-step and parser regressions.

Re-run the parser reverts and both full release gates before the follow-up push.

value.text: Parser follow-up: disjoint integer/decimal and leading-dot alternatives remove overlapping digit quantifiers. node --test test/contrast.test.ts passes 4/4; malformed 200000-digit alpha rejects in a bounded child process (about 124 ms observed). Both probes rebuilt dist, then restored the final parser. The first pushed head passed Node 22/26 release checks, native Bun and Git consumers; CodeQL failed solely on the now-corrected alpha regex. Both full gates are being repeated for the final implementation.
